title: No Free Labels: Limitations of LLM-as-a-Judge Without Human Grounding
authors_zh: Michael Krumdick, Charles Lovering, Varshini Reddy, Seth Ebner, Chris Tanner
paper_type_zh: 专家正确性裁决数据与 LLM-as-a-Judge 人类依据评测
best_for_zh: 需要验证自动评审器是否真正判断正确性、而非仅复现风格偏好的研究者。
one_line: No Free Labels shows that LLM judges need human grounding to reliably grade correctness beyond questions they can answer.
No Free Labels 以金融专家的参考答案和正确性裁决揭示：没有人类依据时，LLM Judge 难以稳定判断正确性。
why: It turns a common evaluator assumption into a testable limitation with expert reference and judgment data.
inclusion_reason: The release provides expert-grounded correctness judgments for testing when LLM-as-a-judge can substitute for human evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM-as-a-Judge often correlates with humans on stylistic preference, but high-stakes domains require factual correctness. When a judge cannot answer a question itself, it may be persuaded by a fluent but wrong candidate; high aggregate agreement can persist because easy questions dominate and hide failure on difficult items.

The paper constructs an expert-annotated finance and general-QA set and compares judging without references, with synthetic references, and with expert references to test whether automated labels can be reliable without human grounding.

LLM-as-a-Judge 在文风偏好上常与人类相关，但高风险领域更需要判断事实正确性。若 Judge 自己不会回答问题，它可能被流畅但错误的候选欺骗；总体一致率仍可能很高，因为容易问题占多数，掩盖在真正困难问题上的失效。

论文构建金融与通用问答的专家标注集，比较无参考、合成参考和专家参考条件下的 Judge 表现，检验自动标签是否能脱离人类知识基础。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper releases BFF-Bench and VERDICTS. BFF-Bench contains 160 challenging questions and long-form answers authored by financial professionals; experts then label the correctness of 1,200 model responses on BFF-Bench and a difficult MT-Bench subset. Records preserve questions, candidate responses, expert references, and verdicts, directly testing correctness rather than general style preference. The key finding is that judging accuracy is strongly linked to whether the judge can solve the question, and high-quality human references can outperform a stronger judge paired with synthetic references.

论文公开 BFF-Bench 与 VERDICTS。BFF-Bench 含 160 个由金融专业人士编写的高难问题和长答案；专家随后对 BFF-Bench 与 MT-Bench 困难子集上的 1,200 个模型回答标注正确性。记录保留问题、候选回答、专家参考与 verdict，可直接测试 Judge 的 correctness，而不是总体风格偏好。核心发现是 Judge 能否答对题与能否判对回答强相关，高质量人类参考比更强 Judge 配合合成参考更有效。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Author professional questions: Financial professionals create 160 long-form questions requiring business and finance knowledge and write correct references.
  1. Collect multi-model responses: Candidate answers are generated for BFF-Bench and difficult MT-Bench questions, covering a range of model abilities and error types.
  1. Obtain expert verdicts: Domain experts inspect questions, references, and responses and label 1,200 correctness verdicts, handling ambiguous or partially correct cases.
  1. Compare judging conditions: Multiple judges are tested without references, with synthetic references, and with expert references, stratified by whether the judge can solve the item. Reproduction requires fixed references and expert labels.

1. 编写专业题目： 金融从业者构造 160 个需要业务和财务基础判断的长答案问题，并撰写正确参考。
  1. 采集多模型回答： 在 BFF-Bench 和 MT-Bench 困难问题上生成候选回答，覆盖不同能力和错误类型。
  1. 专家裁决： 领域专家阅读问题、参考和回答，标注 1,200 条 correctness verdict，并处理模糊或部分正确情况。
  1. 比较 Judge 条件： 测试无参考、合成参考和专家参考的多个 Judge，并按 Judge 是否会做该题分组分析。复现需固定参考来源和专家标签。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Without references, judges agree strongly with experts primarily on questions they can answer correctly themselves, and performance drops on unsolved items. Qwen2.5-7B supplied with high-quality human references can exceed GPT-4o using synthetic references, showing that reference quality can outweigh model scale. This supports the claim that automatic judges cannot create missing knowledge from nothing, although 160 finance questions and 1,200 verdicts do not cover every professional domain.
分析显示，无参考 Judge 只在它自己能正确回答的问题上与专家高度一致；在 Judge 不会的题上性能明显下降。给 Qwen2.5-7B 提供高质量人类参考，其专家一致度可超过 GPT-4o 使用合成参考，说明参考质量能抵消模型规模差距。该证据支持“自动 Judge 不能凭空产生知识”，但 160 个金融题和 1,200 条 verdict 仍不足以覆盖全部专业领域。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier judge benchmarks report aggregate correlation or preference accuracy but rarely stratify by the judge’s own ability to solve the question. This work explicitly links solving and judging and isolates human grounding through controlled reference conditions on the same candidates. It changes the assumed prerequisite for valid judging rather than proposing another prompt template.
既有 Judge benchmark 常报告总体相关或偏好准确率，却很少按 Judge 自身解题能力分层。本文的新意是把“会不会答”和“会不会判”显式连接，并通过同一候选在不同参考条件下的受控实验隔离人类 grounding 的作用。它改变的是 Judge 有效性的前提，而不是设计新的提示模板。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Domain and scale: BFF-Bench focuses on business and finance and the MT-Bench subset is limited. Legal, medical, and code judging require separate validation.
  1. Reference cost: Expert references improve judging but are expensive and may be disputed. High-stakes tasks should retain multiple expert versions and provenance.
  1. Correctness is not all quality: VERDICTS primarily assesses correctness and cannot alone evaluate helpfulness, risk communication, or user preference.

1. 领域与题量： BFF-Bench 聚焦商业金融，MT-Bench 子集也有限；法律、医疗和代码判断需重新验证相同规律。
  1. 参考答案成本： 专家参考能改善 Judge，但本身昂贵且可能存在争议；高风险任务应保留多专家版本和来源。
  1. 正确性非全部质量： VERDICTS 主要判断 correctness，不能单独评价帮助性、风险沟通和用户偏好。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Judge gating: First test whether the judge can solve each item. Unsolved items require expert references or human review rather than relying on aggregate accuracy.
  1. Reference-quality research: Use VERDICTS to compare human, retrieved, and model references and report false positives and false negatives on difficult subsets.
  1. Professional-evaluation construction: Reuse the expert-question, expert-reference, multi-model-response, and expert-verdict pipeline in new domains.

1. Judge 门检： 先测试 Judge 是否能独立答题；不会答的样本必须提供专家参考或转人工，不能沿用总体准确率。
  1. 参考质量研究： 用 VERDICTS 比较人工、检索和模型参考，分别报告困难子集上的假阳性与假阴性。
  1. 专业评测构建： 复用“专家出题—专家参考—多模型回答—专家 verdict”流程，为新领域建立可验证 Judge 集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: No Free Labels shows that judges are unreliable on questions they cannot solve and that human grounding cannot be removed for free.
  1. Method takeaway: Expert finance questions, 1,200 response verdicts, and no-reference, synthetic-reference, and human-reference controls are central.
  1. Data takeaway: BFF-Bench has 160 questions; VERDICTS covers 1,200 responses from finance and a difficult MT-Bench subset.
  1. Evidence anchor: Qwen2.5-7B with expert references can outperform GPT-4o with synthetic references.
  1. Reuse decision: Best for correctness calibration of judges; high-stakes items require high-quality references or human grounding.

1. 一句话定位： No Free Labels 证明 Judge 在自己不会的题上缺乏可靠 correctness 判断，人类参考不是可免费省去的。
  1. 方法抓手： 专家金融题、1,200 条回答裁决以及无参考/合成参考/人工参考对照构成核心。
  1. 数据抓手： BFF-Bench 160 题；VERDICTS 覆盖金融和 MT-Bench 困难子集的 1,200 个回答。
  1. 证据锚点： 带专家参考的 Qwen2.5-7B 可胜过使用合成参考的 GPT-4o。
  1. 复用决定： 适合 Judge correctness 校准；高风险题必须提供高质量参考或人类 grounding。
